title: RSVP with flankers - sentences with semantic and syntactic violations
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from participants performing a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) with flankers reading task involving sentences with semantic and syntactic violations. The study examined neural responses to subject-verb agreement violations, semantic violations, combined violations, and word-order violations compared to grammatically correct control sentences. Data were collected at the NeuroCognition Laboratory at San Diego State University under IRB approval.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room and viewed sentences presented via RSVP with flankers on an LCD monitor at 60 in viewing distance. Each sentence's critical center word was shown in white New Courier font with grey flanker words on either side, presented for 400ms per word with a sliding transition and no ISI. Stimuli included 180 sentences across five conditions: subject-verb agreement violations, semantic violations, double violations, word-order violations, and correct controls (30 each except 60 controls). Participants responded via keyboard and wore a headset for verbal responses.
